product.name: JULES chair (1)
product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with 5 pieces and a board
steps.instruction: Join 5 pieces and a board (A, B, C, D, E, F), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: 5 pieces and a board are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the JULES chair (1). Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (piece, about 4 cm), B (board, about 58 cm), C (piece, about 5 cm), D (piece, about 6 cm), E (piece, about 5 cm), F (piece, about 5 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.

steps.title: Add a leg and a piece
steps.instruction: Attach a leg and a piece (G, H) to what you have built so far, as the animation shows. Page 5 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A leg and a piece are attached

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the JULES chair (1). Page 5 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
